name: Two-Lamp Dyeworks
description: Match a pinned ribbon by irreversible spectral pigment dosing, satisfy the visible active-dye and total-unit lot specification, and compare the sample under two illuminants. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or any other implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to or interact with any pre-existing, unrelated, blank, browser-settings, or non-task tab. A tab opened by a visible task control is allowed only when it is part of the task and only through its visible controls.
natural_language: Use three or four of the available dye families and 8–11 total units to match the pinned ribbon. Stir and dip, then inspect the strip under both lamps: a daylight match may fail under sodium. Seal only after both views agree. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or any other implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to or interact with any pre-existing, unrelated, blank, browser-settings, or non-task tab. A tab opened by a visible task control is allowed only when it is part of the task and only through its visible controls.

metadata.source_notes: Original two-illuminant subtractive-dye workbench grounded in MiniWoB's two colour-wheel tasks and WebGames Color Harmony; no source presentation or asset is copied.
metadata.notes: The browser renders spectral reflectance under two lamps while the server and exported verifier independently replay irreversible doses, stirring, dipping, lamp inspection, vat disposal, and terminal certification.
